enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Turn on back. Move arm. Breathe slowly. Continue sleeping.
Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing work items
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Open bag and place stethoscope inside. Close bag and pick up phone and keys.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Respond to call light. Transport patient. Clean equipment. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Wash hands. Continue patient care. Document notes. Hand over to next shift.

Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat. Walk to kitchen.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table and eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Place plates in dishwasher. Wipe table. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Wash hands. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Get up from sofa. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa and drink. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Put dirty clothes in. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Press start button. Wait for cycle. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Put clothes in dryer. Close dryer and press start button. Remove clothes and fold.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal tasks and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Enter password. Open browser. Check emails. Reply to emails. Open social media. Browse feed. Close social media. Open document. Type notes. Save document. Close document. Shut down laptop. Close laptop. Stand up and walk to bed. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Turn off bathroom light.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Turn on back. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep.
